Este rol será clave para consolidar una cultura ágil, orientada a resultados y conectada a impacto real. Propósito del rol Conectar la estrategia del negocio con la ejecución de los equipos, facilitando la implementación de prácticas ágiles, aportando análisis y contribuyendo a la evolución del modelo operativo y la transformación organizacional. Responsabilidades: Acompañamiento a líderes de equipo: Guiar y fortalecer a los líderes en la gestión de backlogs, roadmaps, priorización y toma de decisiones alineadas a las necesidades del negocio. Seguimiento de madurez de equipos: Ejecutar y dar seguimiento a la aplicación de la matriz de madurez del equipo, identificando brechas, definiendo planes de acción y monitoreando la evolución del modelo operativo. Coordinación y alineamiento entre frentes: Coordinar múltiples equipos en paralelo, asegurando alineamiento entre iniciativas, continuidad operativa y gestión oportuna de dependencias. Gestión ágil de proyectos e iniciativas: Acompañar la planificación y ejecución de proyectos e iniciativas bajo un enfoque ágil, realizando seguimiento a avances, hitos, entregables, dependencias y riesgos, asegurando el alineamiento entre equipos y prioridades del negocio. Visibilidad y gestión de indicadores: Generar visibilidad sobre el avance de la operación mediante indicadores, reportes, tableros y alertas tempranas sobre riesgos o desvíos. Mejora continua de procesos: Identificar cuellos de botella, fricciones y oportunidades de mejora entre áreas, proponiendo ajustes que incrementen fluidez, foco y eficiencia. Facilitación entre negocio y equipos: Conectar prioridades de negocio con la ejecución de los equipos, facilitando decisiones, resolviendo tensiones y traduciendo objetivos estratégicos en acciones operativas. Cultura ágil y gestión del cambio: Impulsar comportamientos ágiles basados en transparencia, foco en valor, colaboración, accountability y mejora continua. Tenga criterio propio y capacidad de influir con argumentos. Sea capaz de incomodar constructivamente cuando sea necesario. Experiencia y Formación + 3 años de experiencia en el rol de Agile Team Coach, Agile Team Facilitator, Scrum Master y relacionados. Experiencia trabajando con múltiples áreas, culturas organizacionales distintas. Participación activa en transformaciones organizacionales o digitales. Haber implementado modelos operativos ágiles a nivel de equipos, áreas y/o gobernanza ejecutiva. Experiencia facilitando workshops, sesiones ejecutivas y dinámicas con líderes. Brindamos Planilla régimen general Beneficios de Ley Respaldo y estabilidad de pertenecer al Grupo HNG. Descuentos en casas de estudio Si te motiva construir un modelo operativo que genere impacto real en negocio y no solo implementar ceremonias, queremos conocerte.

review_candidates.title: eCommerce Solution Analyst / Strategist (Shopify Plus)
review_candidates.description: Design how Shopify Plus, its app ecosystem and connected systems work together to deliver what our clients need. Makro Agency is an eCommerce growth agency and Shopify Premier Partner. We help B2B and DTC brands scale through high-performing Shopify experiences, custom integrations and digital strategy. We're a remote-first, senior team that combines strategy, design and technology to deliver measurable results for our clients. The role You'll own the "how" of our Shopify projects. Once we understand what a client needs, you'll design how Shopify and Shopify Plus, apps, custom development, and back-office systems fit together to deliver it, and make sure what we build holds up in the real world. You'll work across DTC, B2B, and international builds, platform migrations, and ERP integrations, partnering closely with our Business Analyst / Product Owner, designers, and technical leads. You'll be the person who knows what Shopify can do natively, where an app fits, and when something needs to be built. This is a client-facing agency role across multiple eCommerce projects, not ownership of a single brand's platform. What you'll do Assess platform fit and map client requirements to native Shopify and Shopify Plus features, apps, or custom development. Design solutions for B2B, Shopify Markets and internationalization, POS, subscriptions, and multi-store setups. Define integration requirements with ERP, PIM, OMS, and 3PL systems such as NetSuite, SAP, and Microsoft Dynamics 365, including data mapping and sync rules. Scope and plan migrations from other platforms to Shopify, covering data, redirects, and functionality. Evaluate and recommend Shopify apps, and identify gaps that need custom builds. Write functional specifications, solution documentation, and acceptance criteria. Work with technical leads on feasibility, estimates, and trade-offs. Support QA, UAT, and launch, and troubleshoot functional issues after go-live. Explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical clients. What we're looking for 3+ years of hands-on experience delivering Shopify or Shopify Plus projects (required). Agency, consultancy, or systems-integrator experience delivering eCommerce projects for external clients (required). Strong working knowledge of the Shopify admin, native features, Shopify Markets, B2B, checkout extensibility, metafields, Shopify Flow, and the app ecosystem. Experience on at least one integration or platform migration project. Comfort reading API documentation and discussing data flows with developers. You don't need to code. Clear, structured writing for specs and solution documentation. Confidence presenting recommendations and pushing back on clients when needed. Nice to have Migration experience from Magento (Adobe Commerce), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, BigCommerce, or WooCommerce. Hands-on work with ERP integrations such as NetSuite, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics 365. Solution design for B2B or international Shopify Plus stores. Perks and benefits Remote-first culture. Work from anywhere. Competitive salary and benefits package. Competitive paid-time-off policy. Continued education and professional-development opportunities.

review_candidates.title: [UPDATED] Senior Immigration Staff Attorney
review_candidates.description: Senior Immigration Staff Attorney    FLSA Status: Full-Time, Exempt  Division: Legal Programs  Department: Immigration Practice  Reports to: Director, Immigration Practice  Salary: $100,000 - $115,000  Schedule: Hybrid — Minimum of two days per week in the New York City office (Wednesdays and Thursdays), with additional in-office days required based on client, case, court, clinic, and other practice needs.  SUMMARY  The Senior Immigration Staff Attorney provides comprehensive immigration legal services to Her Justice clients, with a particular focus on serving low-income women and gender-diverse people, including survivors of intimate partner violence and other forms of gender-based violence. The Senior Staff Attorney conducts legal consultations and case assessments, provides advice and brief services, prepares appropriate matters for pro bono placement, and maintains a small direct representation caseload involving immigration matters within the scope of the Immigration Practice. A significant component of the role is supporting Her Justice’s pro bono model. The Staff Attorney prepares cases for placement with volunteer attorneys, develops case strategy, and provides ongoing substantive legal mentorship and guidance to volunteer attorneys throughout the life of their cases. This includes case conferencing, reviewing and providing feedback on legal work, supporting preparation for interviews and other proceedings, monitoring case progress, and helping ensure the delivery of high-quality legal services. The Staff Attorney also develops and delivers trainings and substantive legal resources for volunteer attorneys and supports legal clinics and other pro bono initiatives.     RESPONSIBILITIES  Clients  Conduct intake consultations and assess the legal issues of prospective clients for brief services and the suitability for placement with volunteer attorneys.  Provide advice and counsel and/or brief legal services to women and gender diverse people seeking assistance with immigration issues.  Provide client-centered, trauma-informed legal services with sensitivity to the experiences of survivors of intimate partner violence, sexual violence, trafficking, and other forms of trauma.  Where suitable for pro bono placement, prepare cases, have in-person meeting(s) with client, gather documents, provide initial advice to client and prepare case summaries, matching each case with appropriate law firm.  Maintain a small direct representation caseload of immigration clients, independently assessing legal issues, identifying available forms of relief, developing case strategies, preparing and filing applications and other legal submissions, and representing clients in matters within the scope of Her Justice’s Immigration Practice.  Firm Relationships  Assist with the cultivation of volunteer attorneys to handle pro bono cases by making presentations at firms, corporations and bar associations, as and when appropriate.  Serve as a liaison with law firms and build relationships with contacts to enhance pro bono program, and to ensure appropriate placement of clients with each firm.   Mentor and provide substantive legal support to volunteer attorneys throughout the life of their cases, including case strategy, legal research and analysis, document and filing review, case conferencing, preparation for client interviews and proceedings, and troubleshooting complex legal issues.  Monitor the progress and quality of pro bono matters and maintain timely and accurate case information in Her Justice’s case management system.  Assist in organizing and implementing lawyer trainings, including serving as faculty; creating and updating manuals on Her Justice’s substantive areas of law, PowerPoint presentations and additional hand-outs, as appropriate.  Manage and coordinate legal clinics with partnering law firms.    Immigration Practice  Work with the immigration team to assess, develop and strengthen the Her Justice immigration practice.   Remain current on developments in immigration law, policy, procedure, and practice and incorporate relevant developments into client representation, pro bono mentoring, trainings, and practice resources.  Conduct legal research and analysis on emerging and complex immigration issues and contribute to the development of case strategies, practice guidance, and other substantive resources for the Immigration Practice.  Participate in community outreach workshops, walk-in clinics, community information initiatives media relations and other forms of marketing and public education.   Participate in special events, including both fundraising and volunteer recognition events  Serve as a substantive immigration law resource to Her Justice staff, providing legal information, guidance, and consultation on immigration issues affecting clients and organizational work, as appropriate.  Maintain complete, accurate, and timely case records and data, including case notes, deadlines, services provided, case outcomes, and pro bono activity, and provide case, practice, and program updates and reports as required.  Contribute to data collection, case review, program reporting, and other Immigration Practice reporting requirements, as needed.  Recruit, train, mentor, and provide day-to-day guidance to interns, law students, and other volunteers supporting the Immigration Practice, as assigned.  Participate in internal and external committees, working groups, panels, presentations, and policy or systemic reform initiatives related to immigration law and the communities Her Justice serves, as appropriate.  Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations, legal services providers, government agencies, and other stakeholders serving immigrant communities, and identify and facilitate appropriate referrals for clients whose legal or non-legal needs fall outside Her Justice’s scope of services.    QUALIFICATIONS  Required Qualifications Minimum of 5 years of experience practicing immigration law, including substantial experience providing direct legal services to immigrant clients including representing or accompanying clients before USCIS, Immigration Court, ICE, or other government agencies, as applicable to the work of the Immigration Practice.  Strong substantive knowledge of immigration law, policy, and procedure, with demonstrated ability to assess eligibility for immigration relief, identify legal issues, and independently develop and manage appropriate case strategies.  Experience representing clients in immigration matters relevant to Her Justice’s practice, including humanitarian and other forms of immigration relief.  Experience providing legal services to low-income, underserved, or otherwise marginalized communities.  Demonstrated ability to work effectively and sensitively with clients who have experienced trauma, including survivors of intimate partner violence or other forms of gender-based violence.  Demonstrated ability to mentor, advise, or provide substantive legal guidance to attorneys, law students, or other legal professionals.  Professional proficiency or fluency in Spanish or another language commonly spoken by Her Justice clients.  Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and oral advocacy skills.  Strong case management and organizational skills, including the ability to independently manage a caseload, competing priorities, and time-sensitive deadlines.  Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to communicate complex legal concepts effectively to clients, volunteer attorneys, colleagues, and other stakeholders.  Ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and collaborate effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.  Ability to develop and maintain effective working relationships with law firm partners, volunteer attorneys, community-based organizations, and other external partners.  Demonstrated commitment to Her Justice’s mission and to providing high-quality legal services to immigrant communities.  Ability and willingness to work in person as required for client meetings, court and agency appearances, clinics, trainings, and other practice needs.  Proficiency with standard workplace technology and the ability to learn and effectively use case management and other organizational systems.  Preferred Qualifications Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and admission to practice law in New York State, in good standing. ​​​​​​​​​​​ Significant experience representing clients in humanitarian immigration matters, including VAWA self-petitions, U and T visas, I-751 waivers, adjustment of status, and other forms of relief relevant to Her Justice’s Immigration Practice.  Experience working specifically with survivors of intimate partner violence, sexual assault, trafficking, or other forms of gender-based violence.  Experience working with law firms or corporate legal departments in a pro bono legal services model.  Experience developing and delivering legal trainings, CLEs, practice materials, or other substantive legal resources.  Experience supervising or providing ongoing guidance to law students, interns, fellows, paralegals, or volunteers.  Experience conducting community outreach, Know Your Rights presentations, legal clinics, or other community legal education. Work Environment  This is a hybrid position with a minimum of two days per week in Her Justice's New York City office, currently Wednesdays and Thursdays.  Because this is a client-facing role, the Senior Staff Attorney should expect to work in the office more than two days per week when needed to support clients and the work of the Immigration Practice. Additional in-office presence may be required for client meetings, case preparation, clinics, court or other legal proceedings, team needs, and other practice-related responsibilities.  The Senior Staff Attorney must have the flexibility to adjust their in-office schedule based on client and practice needs, with reasonable notice when practicable.

review_candidates.title: Technical Recruiter
review_candidates.description: About Hyphenate Hyphenate (formerly Maximor.ai) is a New York-based startup, founded in 2023 by former Microsoft executives, building AI agents that automate finance and accounting workflows for mid-market and enterprise companies. The platform connects directly to ERP, CRM, billing, payroll, and banking systems to handle tasks like revenue recognition, accounts payable, and reconciliation — replacing the manual, Excel-driven work that has traditionally bogged down finance teams during month-end close. Hyphenate has raised $9M in seed funding led by Foundation Capital, with participation from Gaia Ventures, Boldcap, and others. About the Role Hyphenate is hiring an India-based Technical Recruiter to own outbound sourcing and closing for U.S. software engineering and technical roles. This is a hands-on, outbound-first sourcing role for someone who has already closed engineering hires for a U.S. product company and is comfortable running cold outreach at volume. Work Schedule & Hours This is a remote role based in India that supports a U.S. hiring team. Please note the following before applying: 6-day work week. The role operates on a six-day schedule (Monday through Saturday). Late India-time hours. Working hours are shifted later in the day (IST) to provide meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours for candidate calls, hiring-team syncs, and scheduling. Flexibility on both sides. Exact hours will be agreed with the Head of Talent and may flex around candidate availability across U.S. time zones. Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end sourcing and outbound recruitment for U.S.-based software engineering and technical roles. Design and run outbound campaigns — cold email sequences and cold calling — to build qualified candidate pipelines. Use AI-enabled sourcing tools to identify, enrich, and prioritize candidate lists. Manage candidate communication end-to-end: outreach, screening, scheduling, and pipeline updates. Partner closely with the hiring team to refine sourcing criteria based on candidate quality and market feedback. Required Experience 2–4 years of full-cycle recruiting experience at a fast-growing, U.S.-based startup (seed through Series B). Startup experience must be from a product company — SaaS, AI agents, or enterprise software. E-commerce and non-product companies do not qualify. Track record of having sourced and closed multiple U.S.-based software engineering roles — this is a minimum bar, not a nice-to-have. Strong, demonstrated experience with outbound recruitment: cold email campaigns and cold calling. Inbound recruiting experience is a plus but not required. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Comfortable using AI tools as part of the day-to-day sourcing workflow. Able to commit to a 6-day work week with late India-time hours aligned to U.S. business hours. Consistent, stable work history — frequent unexplained employment gaps will not meet the bar. Preferred / Nice to Have Familiarity with modern AI-powered sourcing platforms such as Juicebox or MetaView. Experience with sourcing/outreach tools commonly used for U.S. technical hiring, such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, hireEZ (formerly Hiretual), SeekOut, GitHub (with tools like Octohunt), and Wellfound (formerly AngelList Talent). Compensation & Benefits Very competitive pay. Compensation benchmarked well above market for the role and experience level. Performance-based bonus. Additional earnings tied to hiring outcomes and pipeline quality. Hiring Process Round 1 — Screening: Introductory conversation with the Hyphenate Head of Talent. Round 2 — Task: A short take-home exercise (a few hours) to assess sourcing approach and output. Round 3 — Paid Work Trial: Successful candidates move to a one-week, paid work trial using Hyphenate's own tools and live requisitions. Final Round: A closing conversation with Hyphenate leadership.

Este rol tiene potencial de evolucionar a Senior Recruiter, Recruiting Lead o roles estratégicos de People a medida que la empresa escale. Tu crecimiento dependerá únicamente de tu desempeño.

review_candidates.description: Description Due to intensive growth, GlobalLogic Automotive department is glad to invite System Test Engineer to an Automotive project. The project aim is to optimize, extend with new features Automotive Solution. Our clients are Tier 1s and OEMs from Europe and USA and development is targeted to Automotive Solution what will be deployed in newest European cars. The project is considered as technical excellence and we are paying huge attention to technical challenge motivation of our team members as well as excellence compensation. At our project we are building a computer-in-the-car architecture – key for enabling innovation within areas such as advanced connectivity, machine learning and autonomous drive. Requirements The System Test Engineer / Developer role focused on ensuring product quality, performance, and reliability through the entire development lifecycle. This role involves designing and implementing comprehensive and executing rigorous functional tests. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background, capable of working with vague requirements and transforming manual test cases into scalable, automated solutions. Job responsibilities Test Execution and Defect Management Execute a variety of tests, including functional, exploratory, regression (diagnostics, communication, etc.). Analyze test results, document a summary report, and identify the root cause of failures, differentiating between product defects and environment issues. Create and manage detailed fault reports and bug tickets for identified product defects. Take responsibility for the proper operation and maintenance of complex test setups. Prepare test objects (e.g. vehicles) by ensuring correct hardware and software baselines are installed and configured. Perform necessary hardware upgrades and technical maintenance in collaboration with engineering teams. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to the testing environment (e.g., invalid HW/SW versions) and implement countermeasures. Maintain automated/manual test scripts and frameworks to improve testing efficiency and coverage, particularly for repetitive and complex test cases. Utilize and interpret data from logs generated by automation environments (e.g., using Python and/or CAPL and/or C#). Test Setup Maintenance (Physical/Hardware Focus) Swedish Driving license is a must Nice to have T1 or T2 driving license What we offer Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. As a team, we engineer digital products that positively impact people’s lives. Empowering Growth: We foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Our dedication is to provide timely and comprehensive assistance for every consultant through our dedicated Learning & Development team, ensuring their continuous growth and success. DE&I Matters: At GlobalLogic, we deeply value and embrace diversity . We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, fostering an inclusive and empowering work environment. Career Development: Our corporate culture places a strong emphasis on career development, offering abundant opportunities for growth. Regular interactions with our teams ensure their engagement, motivation, and recognition. We empower our team members to pursue their career goals with confidence and enthusiasm. Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment. Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company. About GlobalLogic GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
